corrections.evidence: The frozen pytest workflow initially failed because pytest was absent.
The frozen upstream test directly imports pandas and failed because it was absent from requirements.
The baseline preprocessing was incompatible with pandas 3 categorical assignment semantics.

The canonical baseline failed while Lightning reloaded its checkpoint because current PyTorch defaulted torch.load to weights_only=True. The restored run explicitly reported that the environment variable forced weights_only=False and the unchanged workflow passed.
